body:
Riley T.: Hi all, brand-new MBP out of the box. Setup Assistant keeps showing 'Remote Management: Contact your administrator' and MDM shows 'Profile not applicable'. FileVault says 'Off'. I have a 9am sync, any quick help?

IT Support: Hey Riley, welcome! Can you confirm macOS version and paste the serial from: `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep 'Serial'`? Also avoid enabling FileVault manually until we check enrollment.

Riley T.: macOS 14.5, serial C02ABC12345. Ran `profiles status -type enrollment` -> "No enrolled profiles". Setup still loops.

Kai (Onboarding): Thanks, Riley. We sometimes get refurbished units still claimed in DEP. IT, can you look up C02ABC12345?

IT Support: Checking DEP... device is claimed by our returns pool. I'll unclaim and reassign to new-hires. ETA ~10m. Do not create local admin yet unless you need meeting access.

Riley T.: I do need to join now. Can you create a short-lived admin? Prefer a single command to paste.

IT Support: Run this single-line to add a 24h temp admin (paste into Terminal): `sudo sysadminctl -addUser temp_riley -fullName "Temp Riley" -password "RdTmp!2026" -admin`. Log in as temp_riley to continue setup.

Riley T.: Done, I can get in as temp_riley and passed the Remote Management screen.

IT Support: DEP reassign complete. Reboot and sign in with your corp SSO (not temp account). After SSO login check Privacy & Security > FileVault and let us know the prompt text.

Riley T.: Rebooted, signed in with SSO. Got: 'Your recovery key will be saved to your organization's management system'. FileVault is encrypting now. :thumbsup:

Dev Infra: Once fully enrolled we'll push MDM profiles (VPN cert, M1 Rosetta perms, homebrew scripts). Riley you'll get an invite to dev tools group shortly.

Kai (Onboarding): We'll remove temp_riley later today. Riley, welcome to Redwood Inference! If any kernel extension or notarization dialogs pop, screenshot and drop them here.

Riley T.: Thanks everyone 10 super smooth turnaround.

onboarding-bot: Device C02ABC12345 assigned to new-hires and enrolled; temp account temp_riley scheduled for deletion in 24h. Welcome to Redwood Inference!
